description: Canonical Role Registry for B-027 AI Workforce / Work-Control Governance.

roles.title: Human Product & Security Owner
roles.authority: Product and security authority; human-controlled remote write, merge, release, signing, break-glass, E4 attestation, and Accepted Risk decisions.

roles.title: Chief Architect / Technical Governance
roles.authority: Architecture authority, technical governance, and authority-precedence maintenance.

roles.title: Engineering & Continuity Manager / Workforce Orchestrator
roles.authority: Workforce orchestration, continuity, handoff, and deterministic validator maintenance. Not a superuser.

roles.title: Core Implementation Engineer
roles.authority: Implementation of authorized product and tooling tasks within a Task Package.

roles.title: Crypto / Protocol
roles.authority: Cryptographic and protocol implementation and review.

roles.title: Product / Security UX
roles.authority: Product and security user-experience design and review.

roles.title: Independent QA / Adversarial Test
roles.authority: Independent quality and adversarial testing. Must be independent of the writer when required.

roles.title: Platform / SRE / DR
roles.authority: Platform engineering, site reliability, and disaster recovery.

roles.title: Incident Response / PSIRT / Vulnerability Management
roles.authority: Incident response, PSIRT, and vulnerability management.

roles.title: Data Protection / Legal / Compliance
roles.authority: Data protection, legal, and compliance review.

roles.title: Human Release Approver / Signing / Break-glass
roles.authority: Human release approval, signing, and break-glass custody. No AI execution.

roles.title: Independent External Security / Crypto Auditor
roles.authority: Independent external security and crypto audit.

notes: ROLE-001 and ROLE-018 are human-only roles and may not be assigned to AI.
ROLE-003 is an orchestrator, not a superuser.
A model/provider assignment is execution metadata and does not change role authority.
